method: ray casting, 0.5 deg azimuth, spherical curvature, observer 2.0 m above DEM surface
azimuth_convention: clockwise from local north (north = direction away from south pole)
limitations: Near-field obstacles below ~160 m scale not resolved; map-plane distance used for range (PS scale error <0.6% inside 85S); legacy LM1 mask (10 km range) retained for comparison.
